description: This file defines the Dropzone.js library, a JavaScript module for drag-and-drop file uploads, including class definitions, event handling, and module management.

classes.name: Dropzone
classes.description: Main class for managing drag-and-drop file uploads, extending Emitter for event handling.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Custom module loader function resolving dependencies.

methods.name: require.resolve
methods.description: Resolves module paths based on predefined lookup rules.

methods.name: require.register
methods.description: Registers a module with a specific path and definition.

methods.name: require.alias
methods.description: Creates an alias for an existing module path.

methods.name: require.relative
methods.description: Returns a require function relative to a parent path.

methods.name: Dropzone.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes the Dropzone instance, setting up event listeners and UI.

methods.name: Dropzone.prototype.handleFiles
methods.description: Handles an array of files, adding each to the upload queue.

methods.name: Dropzone.prototype.accept
methods.description: Validates a file against size and custom acceptance criteria.

methods.name: Dropzone.prototype.addFile
methods.description: Adds a file to the Dropzone, creating thumbnails and starting upload if applicable.

methods.name: Dropzone.prototype.uploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file via XMLHttpRequest, handling progress and response.
